headline: Council to review grants, donations, National Grid utility petitions, and continued public hearings on zoning and Deacon Farm Lane.
summary: The Council's consent agenda includes new appointments, donations, and grant acceptances including a $132,000 Downtown Initiative Capital Grant and a $124,300 Housing Choice Grant. The agenda also includes several National Grid utility pole and underground facility petitions, continued public hearings on zoning changes and a road layout, and a vote on the November 3, 2026 State Election warrant.
